findings.verdict: the third line (islamweb/Jamiat Ulama Norway) is its own interval-table recipe, not IRN 16/15 and not mawaqeet 18/15
findings.recipe: F/I minute tables: fajr = sunrise - F[day], isha = maghrib + I[day], 730/730 integer-minute offsets; F range 43-106 min (64 values), I range 42-101 min (60 values); identical seasonal lead curve across all 7 cities (city-independent F/I); summer capped at 1/7 of night both ends (fajr lead/night 0.138-0.144)
findings.winterCurve: shared fajr lead Oct-Mar 99/102/105/103/100/97 min, isha lag 82/91/99/94/86/77 min - fits NO single angle (best 11.9 deg rmse 5.9) and no fixed fraction; it is a table, not a formula
findings.separation: same-day gaps vs mawaqeet: fajr +53..+59 mean, isha -35..-40 mean; vs IRN Bergen: fajr +33.6 mean [4..79], isha -19.2 mean [-43..16]; solar columns match mawaqeet/IRN within +/-1 (same engine family, dhuhr +5.5 maghrib +5.5 margins)
findings.asr: Hanafi shadow-2 in 6 cities; Skien anomalous (Shafi fit 96/248)
findings.perCity: candidates cap out at fajr 140-163/365, isha 71-85/365 across the 7 cities - neither mapped line reproduces islamweb anywhere in the year
